import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path.cwd()
source = root / 'scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py'
original = source.read_bytes()
environment = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_') and k not in {'BASH_ENV', 'ENV'}}
results = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hs0002-prefix-counterprobe-') as directory:
    folder = Path(directory)
    log = folder / 'out.log'
    log.write_text('FAIL:reason\n')
    mutant = folder / 'mutant.py'
    before = 'if not line.startswith("FAIL: "):'
    after = 'if not line.startswith("FAIL:"):'
    assert original.decode().count(before) == 1
    mutant.write_text(original.decode().replace(before, after))
    for name, helper, expected_rc in [('normal', source, 1), ('n28-mutant', mutant, 0)]:
        command = [str(root / 'humansearch/.venv/bin/python'), str(helper), str(log), 'FAIL:reason']
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=environment, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
        results.append({'case': name, 'command': command, 'expected_rc': expected_rc, 'actual_rc': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
        assert result.returncode == expected_rc, results
assert source.read_bytes() == original
print(json.dumps({'input': 'FAIL:reason\n', 'expectation': 'FAIL:reason', 'replacement': [before, after], 'results': results, 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(), 'source_unchanged': True}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
